name: CyberBrick Arm
description: Control a CyberBrick robotic arm over USB: turn the base (max 90 degrees left or right of centre), move the arm joints, and open or close the claw.

driverPath.description: Path to arm_serial.py. Default: ../src/arm_serial.py next to this plugin.

python.description: Python interpreter with pyserial installed. Default: the .venv next to arm_serial.py if there is one, otherwise python3.

port.description: Serial port of the arm's receiver board, e.g. /dev/ttyACM0 or COM5. Default: auto-detect.

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest time one arm command may take. Default: 90.
